description: Q3 - the attempt cap. A stakeholder who will not engage with one topic. The agent must ask at most three times, park the dimension with a recorded reason, and carry on rather than deadlock.
purpose_answer: We want to keep an eye on the printers so we stop wasting material on prints that have already failed.

maturity.reasoning: The purpose needs the twin to interpret machine behaviour and act on it.
maturity.description: The twin will watch each job, show you the readings, and work out when the extrusion has gone wrong. It will not predict a failure before it happens and it will not change your settings.

turns.answer: Collect the nozzle and bed temperature continuously during every print job.

requirements.text: The DT shall collect bed and nozzle temperature continuously
requirements.rationale: Temperature is the reading that matters most to us.
